tagline: Keep the decisions, not just the files.

positioning.ideal_buyer: Organizations losing process history, decision rationale and reusable operating knowledge
positioning.buyer_problem: Decisions and ownership disappear in handoffs, forcing teams to rediscover the same work.
positioning.intended_outcome: A scoped institutional-memory design or bounded implementation engagement

delivery_contract.deliverable_to_scope: An agreed memory workflow, record schema, provenance and retrieval plan, and acceptance test or implementation artifact as contracted
delivery_contract.buyer_inputs: One workflow or department, data rights, record ownership, security, retention and retrieval needs
delivery_contract.acceptance_criteria_to_agree: Authorized data boundaries, named workflow, design vs implementation scope, tests and acceptance owner
delivery_contract.exclusions: No entire-enterprise deployment for a fixed blanket scope, compliance certification, unrestricted private data transfer or guaranteed future AI recall

discovery_intents: stop losing decisions during employee handoffs
document why business decisions were made
acquisition.content_angle: When the reasons disappear, the same mistakes become new projects.
acquisition.approved_example_copy: Your company should not lose hard-won knowledge every time responsibilities change. Evercraft Institutional Memory is a $1,500 scoped design or implementation engagement, with sources, rights and acceptance criteria agreed first.
acquisition.distribution_rule: Use owned or authorized channels and qualified, permissioned audiences only. Do not claim posts, leads, conversion or revenue without source receipts.

evercraft_os.relationship: Independent market-facing product, sharing future Evercraft OS capabilities
evercraft_os.module_context: Evercraft OS / Mnemosyne & Context (integration requires separate evidence)

launch_evidence: Existing exact-price Stripe service page tested historically, with owner-shared buyer-view screenshots. This is not a new live purchase or automated delivery attestation.

design.typography: bookish serif headline with precise metadata typography
design.motif: overlapping rings, archival stamps and provenance threads

identity.signature_phrase: Keep the reason, not just the record.
identity.purpose: Preserve how a team reached decisions, who owns the next action and where the evidence lives.
identity.narrative_promise: Continuity is something a team can design.
